metadata.title: Demo Reel (disposable fixture for fill_slates.py)
metadata.note: Two beats will register as SLATES (no media, no pattern, not silent). One beat has an existing pattern (skipped). One beat is silent (skipped). One beat already has media/B04.mp4 on disk (skipped).

beats.name: cold open
beats.narration_text: This first beat has no media and no remotion pattern yet, so fill_slates will stamp it.

beats.name: second beat
beats.narration_text: Another empty beat — a full sentence so the truncate helper actually trims to eleven words with an ellipsis at the end here.

beats.name: pre-authored composer beat
beats.narration_text: This beat already carries a shot.remotion.pattern, so fill_slates leaves it alone.

beats.name: already-rendered beat
beats.narration_text: This one has a real media/B04.mp4 on disk, so fill_slates skips it.
